completion_data.completion_summary: Fixed artifact linking bug in SKILL.md Stage 5 (skill_link_artifacts was never called during orchestration); added multi-task mode to skill-orchestrate with Stages 0 and MT-1 through MT-5 for wave-based phase-aware dispatch; updated orchestrate.md Step 4 to use single skill dispatch instead of N instances; synced extension mirrors.

memory_candidates.content: When adding new functionality to skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md, always check .claude/extensions/core/skills/skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md for a mirror copy that needs the same changes. Similarly, .claude/commands/orchestrate.md has a mirror at .claude/extensions/core/commands/orchestrate.md. Use diff to verify both are in sync after edits.

The skill_link_artifacts() function in skill-base.sh requires these parameters: task_number, artifact_path, artifact_type (report/plan/summary), artifact_summary, field_name (**Research**/**Plan**/**Summary**), next_field (**Plan**/**Description**). The artifact type report maps to field_name=**Research** and next_field=**Plan**; plan and summary both map to next_field=**Description**.
